caption:
the start was exciting. the result will be too.

right now it's just the middle.

are you in the dip right now? 👇

slides.text:
why does the middle
feel so boring?
slides.image: treadmill black white routine running in place

slides.query: what is the dip seth godin
slides.result: Seth Godin calls it **the dip:** the long, hard stretch between starting something and getting good at it, where most people quit.

slides.text:
the beginning is fun because it's new
the end is fun because it's working
slides.image: running shoe close dark first step

slides.text:
the middle is just
you showing up

most people read the dip as a sign to stop
maybe it's a sign you're actually in it
slides.image: hooded figure sitting dark gym exhaustion

slides.text:
if it feels boring right now
you might be exactly where you're supposed to be
slides.image: pull up silhouette sunset rise rebirth
